aadhaarNumber: Your Aadhaar card verifies your identity as the owner of the business. It helps prevent identity theft and ensures only you can manage your registration.
panNumber: Your PAN card is used to link your business activities with tax records. It is a mandatory requirement to verify your financial identity.
name: This is your official name as shown on your government ID. It must match your Aadhaar card so the system can confirm you are the authorized owner.
businessName: This is the official name of your shop or enterprise. It will be printed on your final registration certificate so customers and banks can identify your business.
businessAddress: This is the physical location where your business operates. The government uses this to map where industries are located and send any official mail.
businessType: This describes how your business is legally owned, such as a sole owner, a partnership, or a private company. It determines which rules and tax laws apply to you.
panOfBusiness: This is the separate tax registration card for your business. It is only needed if your business is registered as a partnership or private company rather than owned solely by you.
bankAccountDetails: This is where your business receives government subsidies, loans, or direct payments. Providing this ensures you can get official financial support.
majorActivity: This tells the government if your business makes physical products or provides services. It helps classify your business for different government support programs.
mobileNumber: The mobile number linked with your Aadhaar, used to sign documents via OTP.
gstin: Used for verifying your business with tax departments. Needed if your enterprise is GST registered.
bankAccountNumber: The account number where subsidies and scheme payouts are credited.
ifscCode: The unique branch code used to ensure bank transfers route correctly to your branch.
nicCode: A classification code representing the exact nature of your business activities.
investment: The total capital invested in plant, machinery, or equipment.
turnover: The total sales or revenue generated by your business during the financial year.
